verdict: M165r2 is a valid corrected-identity standalone successor to M164. Exact-SHA VCS exercises a full owned raw FIFO, one same-cycle rank2 release plus producer push, downstream stalls and the exact H67 maximum population; the corrected per-hidden-lane total is 192700. Matched logic-only DC removes exactly the 912 mapped quant_raw flip-flops, reducing area by 6.626943% versus M164 at a 0.0187 ns setup-slack cost. The result is citable only as a module-level same-flow logic-only A/B. The next milestone should close coefficient prefolding plus rank3-left plus ATLIF, not spend another milestone on snapshot-only area trimming.

identity.dc_identity_bridge: The sealed DC binds the revoked-total r1 VCS receipt, but both r1/r2 use the identical RTL SHA. The metadata-only correction overlay and corrected r2 VCS seal provide a reviewable bridge; a post-run admission overlay should consolidate it.

per_hidden_lane_equations: 96350 accepted beats / 5 beats per tile = 19270 tiles
19270 tiles * 10 samples per lane per tile = 192700 samples per lane
3083200 total Q8 samples / 16 hidden lanes = 192700 samples per lane

direct_raw_bank_ownership.raw_count_definition: queued raw entries including the bank currently owned by the requantizer
direct_raw_bank_ownership.ownership_starts: raw_start when idle, raw_count is nonzero and output capacity is reserved
direct_raw_bank_ownership.ownership_ends: rank2 output commit, not service start
direct_raw_bank_ownership.same_cycle_full_release_push: When count=2, wr_ptr equals rd_ptr. On a rank2 release plus final-beat push, the requant RHS reads the pre-edge owned bank and the nonblocking producer write replaces that same bank after sampling; both pointers advance and count remains two.

ii_and_elasticity.one_bank_tradeoff: A one-bank variant preserves no-backpressure II=5 but loses one completed-tile (five-cycle) burst cushion in the modeled 40-cycle rank-output stall.
ii_and_elasticity.scope: Standalone accepted-beat recurrence only; not a complete BN, FFN, network or baseline speed claim.

mapped_netlist_ab.flow_match: same TSMC28 libraries, 3.0 ns clock, 0.2 ns setup uncertainty, 0.05 ns hold uncertainty, 0.25 ns I/O delay, flattened compile_ultra, ZeroWireload, ideal clock and zero macros
mapped_netlist_ab.admission: The exact values are admissible only as same-flow pre-macro logic-only module A/B results, not as placed/routed PPA, Fmax, power, energy or speedup.

next_storage_options.decision: Do not open a snapshot-only or one-raw-bank milestone next. Preserve the verified depth-2 elasticity. Consume/own the moment bank directly inside the future coefficient engine, where a group-boundary bubble or lane-serial read can be evaluated with the real barrier schedule.

conditional_backend_schedule.interpretation: Five-cycle backend II is feasible as a resource schedule, not yet an implemented or measured cycle result. Full rank3 is ten cycles per tile and must be compared with a complete same-resource dense path.

96 lane-specific Lprime coefficient reads per cycle
32 biasprime reads and 32 add/ATLIF threshold lanes per cycle

coefficient_prefold_rank3_left_atlif.priority_decision: Proceed to the conditional dynamic-BN coefficient-prefold plus rank3-left plus ATLIF backend. It closes the largest scientific P0 and exposes a fair module-speed boundary; another roughly 1k-FF storage-only trim does not.

findings.title: PAFT, valid825 and checkpoint-bound Q8 factors remain absent
findings.evidence: M165r2 uses synthetic signed-INT8 factors and inputs. The frozen ep35 model is dense rank-zero; no accepted PAFT factor payload, fc1-to-Q8 bridge or valid825 network result is bound.
findings.required_fix: Freeze the recovered PAFT state_dict and all twelve L/R, scale, shift and threshold identities, then pass the predeclared valid825 gates and hardware-order golden vectors.

findings.title: The measured module still ends before coefficient generation, left projection and ATLIF
findings.evidence: The frontend produces moments and rank-right packets only. No reciprocal-sqrt, dynamic alpha/offset, prefold, rank-state SRAM replay, left projection, threshold or same-resource dense comparison exists.
findings.required_fix: Implement the conditional 16-lane coefficient-prefold plus five-cycle rank3-left/ATLIF backend and pair it with a complete dense dynamic-BN temporal baseline.

findings.title: DC provenance directly binds the revoked-total r1 VCS receipt
findings.evidence: The DC RTL SHA is identical to corrected r2 and the correction is metadata-only, so physical numbers are unchanged; however the immutable DC precontract names the old VCS contract/receipt rather than the corrected r2 seal.
findings.required_fix: Add one post-run admission overlay binding the correction overlay, corrected r2 VCS receipt and sealed DC receipt without rewriting old evidence.

findings.title: No mapped RTL-to-gate equivalence receipt exists
findings.evidence: VCS and DC are exact-SHA sealed, but there is no Formality closure for direct owned-bank old-read/new-write behavior.
findings.required_fix: Run Formality when the commercial queue permits; retain synthesis-only wording meanwhile.

findings.title: The A/B is pre-macro logic-only with zero rounded hold margin
findings.evidence: Both designs use ideal clock, ZeroWireload, 1939 top ports and zero macros; M165 hold slack reports 0.0000 ns and has no CTS/parasitics/SAIF/PTPX.
findings.required_fix: Keep the exact logic-only qualifier and add a realistic wrapper, SRAM choice, CTS/parasitics and power evidence before physical PPA claims.

findings.title: Maximum population is reached but overflow and extent attacks remain absent
findings.evidence: The 192000-sample terminal channel is valid and covered, but the TB does not hold it non-last and attempt another beat. The interface also lacks stage/group/spatial extent authentication.
findings.required_fix: Attack the post-maximum beat and add expected extent plus address ordering in the barrier wrapper.

findings.title: II=5 is a standalone no-backpressure recurrence
findings.evidence: Depth two and depth one both sustain the synthetic no-backpressure stream, but output stalls eventually stop final beats and no SRAM/barrier/backend recurrence is present.
findings.required_fix: Measure address-timed rank-state write/replay and coefficient latency; report a throughput-versus-backpressure curve against the same-resource dense baseline.

findings.title: Dynamic Lprime may invalidate the 8x8 product-slot assumption
findings.evidence: The real prefold is exact, but alpha is data-dependent. Quantizing alpha*L to signed INT8 can overflow or change rounding association, while a wider Lprime cannot inherit 96 signed-8x8 slots.
findings.required_fix: Constrain/rebalance factors during PAFT, freeze per-module binary points, prove all Lprime and biasprime ranges, and train/evaluate the exact fold and saturation order.

findings.title: SVA observes pointers and covers overlap but does not assert owned bank contents
findings.evidence: Functional scoreboard order and independent state enumeration catch corruption, but no property directly states that an owned bank is stable until rank2 or overwritten only on simultaneous release.
findings.required_fix: Expose a bank write-enable/address witness or bind an internal data-stability assertion in the next VCS identity.

findings.title: Seventeen quant metadata FFs remain redundant under direct ownership
findings.evidence: quant_tag_q and quant_last_q copy metadata even though raw_rd_ptr remains stable through rank2; this is small and not worth a separate milestone.
findings.required_fix: Read owned raw metadata directly when integrating the backend, then reverify stalls and config boundaries.

findings.title: Pre-run contracts retain READY and admission-false fields
findings.evidence: Sealed receipts carry the passes, but no immutable post-run overlay records the corrected admissions and review verdict.
findings.required_fix: Create a post-run admission overlay rather than modifying precontracts.

allowed_claims: The corrected exact-SHA M165r2 VCS run derives 192700 samples per hidden lane overall and reaches 192000 samples per lane in one H67 maximum-population channel.
The standalone two-bank controller retains raw-bank ownership until rank2 commit and passes a full-FIFO same-cycle old-read/new-write replacement under backpressure.

Under the matched 3 ns TSMC28 logic-only flow, M165 versus M164 removes exactly 912 sequential cells (13.565373%) and 2808.288087 um2 cell area (6.626943%), while setup slack changes from 0.7492 ns to 0.7305 ns.
Across the same-flow semantic chain from M163r2 to M165, logic-only cell area falls 26.263589% and sequential cells fall 36.720026%.
In real arithmetic, dynamic BN can be prefolded into lane-specific Lprime and biasprime; with admitted INT8 coefficients, 96 product slots can schedule the rank3-left half in five cycles per tile.
forbidden_claims: M165 is a complete dynamic-BN, ATLIF or FFN accelerator
the five-cycle frontend II or conditional backend schedule is an admitted network speedup
1.7x is measured speedup; it is only a conditional 17-cycle dense lower-bound versus 10-cycle full-rank3 schedule before barrier/memory overhead
the logic-only DC result is placed/routed PPA, Fmax, power or energy
one raw bank is free: it removes one tile of output-stall elasticity
PAFT, valid825, rank3 accuracy or signed-INT8 Lprime range has passed
